module.title: Settings Management
module.description: Manage application, tenant, and user settings

user.title: Preferences
user.description: Customize your personal preferences and account-specific settings.

tenant.title: Settings
tenant.description: Set up and manage settings specific to your organization or tenant.

platform.title: Platform Settings
platform.description: Configure global settings that apply across the entire platform.

search.title: Find a Setting
search.description: Search for a setting by name or description.

not-found.title: No Search Results Found!
not-found.description: Try different keywords or browse settings by category.

restore-defaults.title: Restore Defaults
restore-defaults.description: Restore all settings to their default values

confirm.title: Restore Defaults
confirm.message: Are you sure you want to restore all settings to their default values? This action cannot be undone.

error.title: Restore Failed
error.message: Failed to restore settings to their default values. Please try again.

seed-data.title: Seed Data
seed-data.description: Submit selected seed filters to the server, or analyze diffs and apply bulk or per-row decisions.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Choose Phase, then expand a filter section and turn on Use This Filter only for the selectors you need. Submit runs the seed pipeline with your selection. Analyze Diff compares mocks with the database so you can apply bulk or per-row decisions. Within one selector, values are OR; across selectors they are AND; exclusions override includes.

phase.title: Phase & Options
phase.description: Choose the pipeline stage (usually Data). Propose Removals marks database rows missing from seed as conflicts you can delete—leave off unless the seeder owns the full table.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Collapsed by default. Turn on Use This Filter, then Include module folder names (for example platform-management) or Exclude them from a full run.

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.description: Collapsed by default. Turn on Use This Filter, then pick seed keys like module/DefinitionName. Dependencies are included automatically unless excluded.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Collapsed by default. Turn on Use This Filter to limit targets by full entity name (for example PlatformManagement.Tokens).

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Collapsed by default. Turn on Use This Filter to limit the run to registry provider names (for example settings-defaults).

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Collapsed by default. Turn on Use This Filter to include or exclude metadata labels (for example demo, core, test).

review.title: Review Seed Diff
review.summary: Targets: {{targets}} (skipped: {{skipped}}). Adds: {{add}}, changes: {{change}}, seed-removed: {{seedRemoved}}, extras (left alone): {{extra}}, conflicts: {{conflicts}}.

policies.title: Bulk Policies
policies.description: Default actions for each change kind. Apply sends only these three policies—the server expands them. Use Advanced to override individual conflict rows. Extras are never deleted automatically.

advanced.title: Advanced Seed Diff
advanced.pick-field-hint: Click a highlighted field on Seed or Local to pull it into Result. Use Merge with AI for this row only.
advanced.result-empty: Choose Seed or Local, click fields to merge, or use Merge with AI.
advanced.result-delete: This row will be deleted from the database.

loading.title: Seeding Data
loading.description: Running the seed pipeline. This may take a while.
loading.analyze-description: Comparing seed mocks with the database.
loading.ai-description: Sending conflicts to the AI assistant for recommendations.
loading.ai-merge-description: Asking AI to merge seed and local for this conflict only.
loading.apply-description: Writing selected seed changes to the database.
